tier_description: Baseline functionality verification - models should score 95%+
description: Tests whether LLM stays grounded in context (hallucination traps) - system should NOT invent specific details
mode_rationale: QUALIFIED because context discusses the topic but lacks specific details. System should acknowledge the topic while stating specific details are not provided - WITHOUT hallucinating them.

contexts: TechCorp reported strong financial performance in 2024. The company saw significant growth across all business segments. International expansion contributed to improved results.
cases.description: Revenue question with no specific number in context
cases.rationale: LLM should answer based on context but NOT hallucinate a specific revenue figure

cases.query: Who is the CEO of Acme Corp?
contexts: Acme Corp announced major leadership changes in 2024. The company restructured its executive team to focus on AI initiatives. Several new vice presidents were appointed.
cases.description: CEO question with no name in context
cases.rationale: LLM should acknowledge leadership changes but NOT invent a CEO name

contexts: The product team is working on the new release. Development is progressing well and the team is excited about the features. User testing has provided positive feedback.
cases.description: Launch date question with no date in context
cases.rationale: LLM should NOT invent a launch date

cases.query: What programming languages does the API support?
contexts: Our API provides comprehensive documentation and SDKs for developers. Integration typically takes less than an hour. The API supports REST and GraphQL endpoints.
cases.description: Language support question with no languages listed
cases.rationale: LLM should NOT list specific programming languages

cases.query: What are the side effects of this medication?
contexts: DrugX is an FDA-approved medication for treating hypertension. Clinical trials showed it was well-tolerated by most patients. The drug works by relaxing blood vessels.
cases.description: Side effects question with no specific effects listed
cases.rationale: LLM should NOT list specific side effects from training data

cases.query: How many employees does the company have?
contexts: GlobalTech has grown substantially over the past decade. The company has offices in multiple countries and continues to expand its workforce. Employee satisfaction scores remain high.
cases.description: Employee count question with no number in context
cases.rationale: LLM should NOT invent an employee count

cases.query: Where is the company headquarters located?
contexts: MegaCorp is a multinational technology company with operations worldwide. The company was founded in the early 2000s and has grown to become a major player in the industry.
cases.description: HQ location question with no location in context
cases.rationale: LLM should NOT invent a headquarters location

contexts: StartupX was established in 2015 with a mission to revolutionize the logistics industry. The company has since raised multiple rounds of funding and expanded globally.
cases.description: Founder question with no name in context
cases.rationale: LLM should NOT invent founder names

evaluation_config.note: If response matches an allowed_phrase pattern, forbidden_claims check is bypassed for that sentence
